title: Islamic Expansion in Africa (c. 650-1900)
key_facts: Gradual spread of Islam across African continent through trade and conquest
North Africa fully Islamized by 10th century
West African kingdoms converted through trade networks
causes: Trade routes connecting African kingdoms to Islamic world
outcome: Islam became major religion in North and West Africa
Creation of unique African Islamic cultures and traditions
Arabic script adopted for African languages
Islamic law and governance systems established

figures.name: Uqba ibn Nafi
figures.role: Arab general who conquered North Africa

impacts: Unified diverse African regions under common religious identity
Preservation and development of Islamic scholarship
Resistance to European colonization through Islamic solidarity
